description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility for logging purposes. It facilitates chaining of log nodes for flexible log handling and formats log messages, including exceptions, before passing them on.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility and implements the LogNode interface to facilitate logging with chaining support.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which logs will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Performs the actual logging operation, formatting messages and handling exceptions, then forwarding to the Android Log system and the next node.
